## Summary
Gaven, your performance over the last few weeks has been impressive, consistently exceeding the weekly goal hours, with a peak of 70.1 hours in the week of April 25 to May 1. However, it’s important to address the lack of billed repair orders (ROs) recently, as this impacts our overall service revenue.

## What's Working
- **Strong Hourly Performance**: You achieved 63.9 hours during the week of May 23 to May 29, hitting 117.7% of your weekly goal. Great job on maintaining high productivity! 📈
- **Consistent Improvement**: Over the last six weeks, your performance has consistently exceeded the goal, with totals ranging from 59.5 to 70.1 hours. This shows a strong upward trend in your work ethic and efficiency.
- **Effective Time Management**: You allocated significant hours on high-earning days, such as 27.9 hours on Thursday, May 5, demonstrating good time management skills.

## Where to Focus
- **Lack of Billed ROs**: Despite high hour totals, you have not billed any ROs in the last three weeks. This is critical as it affects our revenue. Focus on converting your hours into billed work by prioritizing open ROs. For example, RO 777092 (timing issue) is high-priority and parts are ready. Aim to complete this by mid-week to generate revenue.
- **Aging WIP**: You have several open ROs that are aging, with RO 777425 (19 days old) and RO 777748 (9 days old). These need your attention to avoid further delays. Set a goal to check in on parts availability for RO 777425 and complete battery testing for RO 777748 this week.
- **Job Assignment**: There are multiple jobs awaiting assignment, such as RO 777988 (check engine light) and RO 777947 (metal shavings in oil). Picking up these jobs can help you convert your hours into billed work. Aim to select at least one of these ROs to work on this week.

## Action Items for This Week
1. Prioritize completing RO 777092 (timing issue) by mid-week to ensure timely billing.
2. Follow up on parts for RO 777425 and start working on RO 777748 to reduce aging WIP.
3. Select and begin work on at least one job from the shared queue, such as RO 777988, to increase your billed ROs.

## WIP Watchlist
- **RO 777092 (30d old)** — Timing issue, high-priority, parts are here. Complete this soon!
- **RO 777425 (19d old)** — Engine warranty extension, parts on backorder. Stay updated on ETA.
- **RO 777748 (9d old)** — EV powertrain issue, more battery testing needed. Prioritize this to avoid further delays. 

Keep up the great work, Gaven! Let’s convert those hours into billed ROs this week! 🔧
